title: G's Dash
description: Driver display in nine looks (M Style, GT, Digital '84, Sim Racing, Lumen, Pixel, Vector, Space, Aura). Swipe between Drive, Warm-up, G-force and Tires, with an optional Spotify panel. Logo is the G mark by default, or a GIF from your phone, on the home widget, in the cluster, and on Drive's right panel when that panel is Logo. Per driving mode (off by default) gives each reported mode its own GIF; an empty slot keeps the main Logo. With the Cluster renderer tool, one tap picks the cluster's centre and dials & HUD. CarPlay's map needs the Waze on cluster tool (off by default). Spotify needs Premium and mgu-uplink. Optional encrypted crash logs need the unit's own private drop.

de.bmw.infotainment.drivingexcitement.FE._optional: the drive mode badge, and which per-mode Logo plays: statusFESVehicleDynamicSwitchHMI.actualValueModeDrivingExperience (enum ActualValueModeDrivingExperience2, by name or number); its pop-up request flags mark a change

de.bmw.infotainment.misc.MDrive._optional: the gearbox program beside the gear (DS, M3): dataDisplayGearbox.displayProgramGearbox (S / M program, by name or number; notifier only); without it the gear shows as before

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.TPMS._optional: the Tires screen: pressures, temperatures, targets, status (UInt16 raw: pressure x0.1 in the car's unit, temperature raw-40; read every 10 s; raw values logged and on the diagnostics page)

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle._optional: the car's display units (air pressure, temperature) for the TPMS values

de.bmw.infotainment.navigation.navigatio._optional: the cluster logo's route guidance check: guidingState (INACTIVE / CALCULATING_ROUTE / ACTIVE; ACTIVE hides the logo); without it the logo goes by the phone's signals, and with none it stays shown

de.bmw.infotainment.a4a.carplay.CarPlayM._optional: the cluster logo's CarPlay route guidance check (Waze or Maps with a route): projectedGuidanceActive; without it the logo shows over Waze's map during a CarPlay route too

de.bmw.infotainment.sdi.aap.androidautop._optional: the cluster logo's Android Auto route guidance check: projectedGuidanceActive

config.comment: Logo > Send a GIF (kit/runtime/gif_drop.js): widgetRelay is the public phone page (https, holds no secrets; web/widget/ on the gh-pages branch), widgetMailbox the ntfy server the phone and the car meet on (everything on it AES-256-GCM sealed; the published page talks to https://ntfy.sh only).

startWidget.comment: Home-screen widget and the same picture as Logo. Layout is BMW's LT_Table_BasicWidget (common/widget/generated/Spec_MainMenuWidgets.pbw): BackgroundImage_Big and BackgroundImage_Small are LT_Label_WidgetBackground, a full-widget picture with no mask, so the Drive Recorder vignette is not drawn. The picture G's Dash draws is 'size' (the G mark in widget_logo.js, or My GIF); the HMI scales it into Big and Small. Text cells stay empty. 'safe' is the inset already baked into the G mark; how the new layout crops that picture still has to be checked on the car. My GIF plays in this picture (kit/runtime/widget_anim.js). stream: the stream widget template the Store's renderer would mount (docs/animated-widget.md), used by kit/tools/build.py only when the renderer's marker file names it, else this layout.
